units: meters, Y-up in web; Z-up in Blender .blend

facing.note: 3D free-turn fighter: mesh faces opponent at runtime. Key poses stored neutral/forward. Mirror only if baking 2D-style L/R sheets.
facing.kol_compat: KOL sprite pipeline still uses -r / -l. Polygonal 3D uses one pose + yaw toward opponent.

controlScheme.summary: WASD 8-way move (diagonals normalized) + Arrow keys attack diamond. Mobile mirrors: left stick + 4 face buttons.
controlScheme.whyBest: Left hand move / right hand attack is natural on PC and maps 1:1 to mobile twin-stick fighters. Arrows never fight WASD. Diagonals (WA/WD/SA/SD) use vector normalize so you are not faster on diagonals.

mobile.move: virtual stick (left) — same 8-way as WASD including diagonals
mobile.jump: optional JUMP pad or stick flick up
mobile.layout: left stick · right diamond (up special, down block, left punch, right kick)

gamepad.jump: LB or A-alternate — prefer LB so A stays kick

strengthRules.forward_plus_button: heavy (W or stick forward while attacking)

tiers.A_mvp: Ship playable 1v1 on phone. Minimum poses to animate on BaseFighter.
tiers.B_standard: Full arcade feel. Matches existing KOL Fighter pose registry.
tiers.C_3d_extra: True free-3D feel (dash, sidestep). Add after MVP.

poses.label: Idle / Fight stance
poses.blurb: Default combat stance. Weight on balls of feet, hands up. Base for all characters.

poses.label: Idle breath
poses.blurb: Subtle chest/shoulder shift so idle is not frozen. Alternate with idle every ~1s.

poses.label: Walk forward A
poses.blurb: Contact / pass pose A toward opponent.

poses.label: Walk forward B
poses.blurb: Opposite foot. Flip with walkForward1 for cycle.

poses.label: Walk back A
poses.blurb: Retreat step A. Guard stays higher.

poses.label: Walk back B
poses.blurb: Retreat step B.

poses.label: Crouch
poses.blurb: Low guard. Evades highs. Source for low block / low attacks.

poses.label: Jump rise
poses.blurb: Leaving ground, knees tucked, arms balance.

poses.label: Jump peak
poses.blurb: Apex hang pose.

poses.label: Fall / land prep
poses.blurb: Descending. Knees ready to absorb landing.

poses.label: Block high / mid
poses.blurb: Standing guard. Forearms up. Mobile: hold B standing.

poses.label: Block low
poses.blurb: Crouch guard. Mobile: hold B while stick down.

poses.label: Hit stun (stand)
poses.blurb: Standing reaction. Recoil torso / head snap.

poses.label: Hit stun (crouch)
poses.blurb: Low hit reaction while crouched.

poses.label: Knockdown
poses.blurb: On back / side on the ring. KO and hard hits.

poses.label: Get up
poses.blurb: Rising from knockdown back to stance.

poses.label: Jab (light punch)
poses.blurb: Fast lead hand. MVP stand-in for high punch.

poses.label: Medium punch
poses.blurb: Body / face cross. Mid damage.

poses.label: Heavy punch
poses.blurb: Committed power punch. Longer recovery.

poses.label: Low punch
poses.blurb: Crouching jab / body shot.

poses.label: Low kick
poses.blurb: Shin / ankle kick. Beats stand block if low.

poses.label: Medium kick
poses.blurb: Mid roundhouse / front kick.

poses.label: Heavy kick
poses.blurb: High / launching kick. Slow and punishable.

poses.label: High kick
poses.mobile: alias of heavyKick for KOL parity
poses.blurb: Kept for KOL sprite name parity.

poses.label: Special 1
poses.blurb: Character signature A (rush / palm / spin). Shared animation slot; per-KOL VFX later.

poses.label: Special 2
poses.blurb: Signature B / finisher slot.

poses.label: Throw (attacker)
poses.blurb: Grab / hip throw peak. Beats pure block.

poses.label: Thrown (victim)
poses.blurb: Being tossed. Mirrors throw timing.

poses.label: Victory
poses.blurb: Round / match win. Per-character personality later.

poses.label: Defeat
poses.blurb: Loss pose. Can reuse knockdown + hold.

poses.label: Dash forward
poses.blurb: VF-style step-in. Add after MVP.

poses.label: Dash back
poses.blurb: Quick retreat.

poses.label: Sidestep left
poses.mobile: optional: stick flick up/left relative to camera
poses.blurb: True 3D circle-out. Skip until ring movement feels good.

poses.label: Sidestep right
poses.blurb: Mirror of sidestep L.

poses.label: Taunt
poses.blurb: Optional KOL personality / boss flavor.

attackPhaseGuide.startup: Wind-up. No hitbox yet. ~2–5 frames mobile.
attackPhaseGuide.active: Hit frame pose. Hitbox ON. 1 key pose required minimum.
attackPhaseGuide.mvpShortcut: For Tier A, author the ACTIVE pose first. Startup/recovery can blend from idle until polish.

kolOverlayPlan.step1: Animate poses on BaseFighter rig only (shared skeleton).
kolOverlayPlan.step2: Each KOL character = skin / mesh variant parented to same bones (no re-animate per KOL for MVP).
kolOverlayPlan.step3: Optional per-KOL: victory, special1, special2, taunt only.
kolOverlayPlan.step4: Existing 2D pose folders under assets/images/kol-fighter/characters/*/poses stay as art reference until 3D skins land.
kolOverlayPlan.sharedSkeleton: BaseFighter_Rig bone names are the contract for every KOL mesh.

counts.note: Tier A is enough for playable mobile 1v1. Attack poses use 1 active key first; expand to 3 phases later.
